title: Apply to recommence trading
summary: Find out how to apply to recommence trading under your liquor licence after a break of six weeks or more.
intro:
To recommence trading under your liquor licence after a break of 6 weeks or more, lodge an application through the liquor licence manager.

For up-to-date liquor licence guidelines, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor licensing contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: Any person or organisation holding a current NSW liquor licence.
what_you_need: A MyServiceNSW Account (you can create one when you start your application)
The date the premises is intending to re-commence trade.

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Go to Liquor Licence Manager' button
Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Select 'View details' on the licence you want to amend.
Follow the prompts to complete the application.

external_links.text: Manage, modify or move your liquor licence – Liquor & Gaming NSW

faqs.q: Who can apply to recommence trading?
faqs.a: Any person or organisation that holds a current NSW liquor licence.

faqs.q: Where can I find up-to-date liquor licence guidelines?
faqs.a: Visit the Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing page.
